test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that best explains the underlined idiom in the given sentence.

A team's captain always keeps __a level head__, even in the most challenging situations.

options.text: Prefers to keep his head covered with a cap
Maintains an equal number of players on the field
Keeps his head protected with a helmet

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"keeps a level head"** means **to remain calm and composed, especially in difficult situations.** (शांत और संयमित रहना) • **Example: **Despite the chaos around him, the manager **kept a level head** and handled the situation efficiently. • **"Remains calm and composed"** refers to someone who does not get easily agitated or upset and maintains their composure. (शांत और संयमित रहना) • **Example: **Even during the crisis, she **remained calm and composed,** guiding everyone to safety. Therefore, the correct answer is: ***'Remains calm and composed'.*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Prefers to keep his head covered with a cap** (अपना सिर टोपी से ढकना पसंद करता है): This option is incorrect as it refers to a physical action of covering the head with a cap. • **Example:** He prefers to keep his head covered with a cap during sunny days. • **Maintains an equal number of players on the field** (मैदान पर खिलाड़ियों की समान संख्या बनाए रखना): This option is incorrect as it refers to ensuring an equal number of players in a sports context. • **Example:** The referee ensures that each team maintains an equal number of players on the field. • **Keeps his head protected with a helmet** (अपना सिर हेलमेट से सुरक्षित रखता है): This option is incorrect as it refers to the physical action of wearing a helmet for protection. • **Example:** He keeps his head protected with a helmet while riding his bike. 2e0:Tc5e, The correct answer is: **Option 1)**
